_comment: Ticket 162 — the unavailable-aggregate refusal, shared across tiers. An agg node the compiler cannot statically register is a PUBLISH-TIME refusal (150-family direction: rule.compile.bad_grammar, both tiers); a WELL-FORMED agg whose evaluation context carries no tables (the guard tier's flat bag) refuses at runtime with rule.bad_reference and the address params {agg: 'section/fn/col'} — this file pins that params SHAPE byte-identically so a param-order swap in one tier splits the corpus, not just a unit test.

cases._comment: CONTRACT FORK (absent-vs-empty, report-only): the instance model cannot distinguish a section that is ABSENT from one that is EMPTY — RuleInstance.fromJson routes both to zero rows, so a well-formed arity-3 aggregate over an absent section folds over nothing and computes count 0 through its registered fold cell. This case makes that boundary VISIBLE and deliberate, not accidental; changing the instance-model contract to refuse absent sections is a separate decision (the real fabrication chokepoint is the instance model, not this fold).
cases.name: agg/absent-section-count-zero

cases._comment: Arity-4 agg node: reference extraction cannot statically register it, so the compiler refuses at publish (it previously skipped registration and refused per-keystroke at runtime with no authoring-time signal).
cases.name: agg/unregistrable-arity-refuses-at-compile

cases._comment: Expression-valued agg arg: it previously registered a phantom String()-coerced cell in the TS tier and threw an untyped exception in the .NET tier — now one identical compile refusal.
cases.name: agg/unregistrable-dynamic-arg-refuses-at-compile

cases._comment: A compiled, well-formed aggregate reference evaluated where no tables exist (the guard tier's flat context bag) is unavailable data: rule.bad_reference with params {agg: 'section/fn/col'} — section first, then fn, then col. Both tiers construct this through ONE shared factory (RefValue.UnavailableAggregate / unavailableAggregate); this case pins the shape across tiers.
cases.name: agg/unavailable-refuses-in-guard-context
